summary.en: A thick band of colour grows round the frame, then on one frame flips to the other colour of the pair; band, label and content change together with a short flash and a bounce.
summary.zh: 一圈粗色带先于内容长出包住全屏，再在同一帧翻成另一种颜色：色带、角标和框内画面一起换，带一下白闪和框厚回弹。

fits: A product with two modes (design and code, edit and preview, draft and review) when the film switches between them; a section frame that says the whole view is in one state.
notFor: Ordinary cuts between shots (the flip says mode, not next); more than one flip pair in a film; scenes whose own edges carry information (the band covers 60 px).

intent.en: The colour of the frame becomes the code for a mode, so one hard flip says "we switched modes" without touching the content.
intent.zh: 画框颜色成了模式的代号，一次硬翻色就说清“换模式了”，不用动内容本身。

content.en: The scenes before and after the flip (often two screen recordings), two short mode labels (≤ 12 chars each) and an optional right-hand mark.
content.zh: 翻色前后的两个场景（常是两段录屏），两个短的模式标签（每个 ≤ 6 字），右侧标记可选。

fits.zh: 有两种模式的产品（设计与代码、编辑与预览、草稿与审阅）在片中切换时；或用一圈框说明“整屏都处在某个状态”。

notFor.zh: 普通的镜头间切换（翻色说的是换模式，不是下一个）；一支片里不止一对翻色；边缘本身有信息的画面（色带盖住 60 px）。

pairs.note: a click on the mode toggle right before the flip makes it read as caused

en: Band, label and content must change on the same frame; even 2 frames apart it falls into three small animations.
Keep the colour code for the whole film: no UI in the other mode's colour inside a band.
The two band colours need opposed hue and a clear lightness gap; neighbours of one lightness look like no flip.
At most two flips a film; more reads as a neon sign.
zh: 色带、角标和内容必须同一帧换，差 2 帧就散成三个小动画。
颜色编码全片守约：某色框里不许出现另一模式颜色的主 UI。
两种框色要色相对冲、明度拉开；同明度邻近色翻了等于没翻。
全片翻色最多两次，多了像霓虹灯。

upstream.name: 品牌画框硬切
upstream.summary: 品牌色画框语法——一圈粗纯色画框先于内容长出包住全屏，录屏窗口落进框内；模式切换时整圈画框同帧硬翻色+窗内布局同帧换，一个 borderColor 干完章节导航/状态提示/品牌露出三件事
upstream.use: 双模式/双章节产品片的全片包装层（蓝=模式A、绿=模式B 颜色编码）；真实录屏素材的品牌化包裹
upstream.energy: 中（翻色瞬间高，其余时间是安静的包装层）
